FIELDS.NAME: Press & Print Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Press & Print Solutions specializes in high-quality printing and copying services for both commercial and residential clients. Our operations encompass a wide range of services including digital printing, offset printing, large format printing, and document reproduction, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and efficiency. Utilizing modern equipment, we ensure optimal performance and quality across all jobs.

We are committed to environmental responsibility, adhering to all local regulations regarding hazardous materials and waste disposal. Our team is trained in safe handling practices for inks and solvents, and we maintain proper ventilation and personal protective equipment on-site to mitigate any health risks associated with our processes.

Our customer service team works closely with clients to create tailored solutions, whether it be a small project or a large-scale print run. We also provide a secure online ordering system, ensuring the protection of customer data with robust cybersecurity measures in place.

In addition, our operations feature a comprehensive maintenance schedule, guaranteeing that all equipment is regularly inspected and serviced, helping us maintain a reliable workflow. Through proactive risk assessments, we continuously identify potential hazards and implement measures to address them, ensuring a safe and efficient working environment for our employees and clients alike.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Press & Print Solutions operates a subsidiary called "Eco Print Innovations," which focuses on sustainable printing solutions and eco-friendly materials.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2023, we experienced a loss due to a malfunction in our digital printing press, resulting in operational downtime and repair costs totaling $2,500. The equipment is currently being serviced, and we expect to resume normal operations by February 15, 2023.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, Non-combustible materials; equipped with fire suppression system and alarm monitoring.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel are employed during high-volume production hours to ensure safety and protect company assets.
